_comment: addrd config for the hivre.com DNS-experimentation lab (homelab
docs/plans/dns-experimentation-lab.md). Only two of upstream's zones are
enabled: the dnscheck probe zone and the dns-01 challenge helper. Dyn and
Myaddr are deliberately omitted -- every zone block in internal/config is
individually optional (nil/len guarded), so leaving them out disables them
entirely rather than needing code changes.
SECRETS: PrivateKey values are base64 raw key material and MUST NOT be
committed. They come from sops + the mkSecretService pattern, same shape as
cloudflare/api_token. This file carries empty placeholders only.
Generate an ECDSA P-256 (algorithm 13) keypair with addrd itself:
addrd -k check.hivre.com. -a 13
That prints three things: the DS record to publish at the registrar
(Metaregistrar, for hivre.com), the DNSKEY record whose final base64 field
is the PublicKey value below, and `;privKey: <base64>` which is the
PrivateKey value. Without the DS published registrar-side the zone
validates as insecure and every 'did your resolver validate?' probe on the
lab page reports the uninteresting answer.
Algorithm 13 (ECDSAP256SHA256) is chosen over 15 (ED25519) for validator
reach, and over anything larger for response size: this zone is directly
public and every byte of signature is amplification ammunition.

_comment_valkey: The label-correlation store. Prefer the existing Valkey HA cluster over
the local db.json: this is short-TTL disposable state, and pointing it at
Valkey keeps the pod itself stateless. Set ValkeyURL to use it (upstream
prefers ValkeyURL over DatabasePath when both are set).
_comment_lookup: The recursive resolver the /api/lookup JSON endpoint queries. The plan
calls for Unbound with `ede: yes` so Extended DNS Errors and the AD bit
are real rather than synthesised. Until that exists, any validating
resolver works, but EDE readouts will be empty.
